decision.reasoning: The issue asks users to validate ORT 1.28.0 before release, identifies a release branch and manager, and publishes prerelease packages. The authoritative final v1.28.0 release now exists, so this candidate is historical despite the issue remaining open. For a Windows x64 standalone EP host, Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime is the applicable native base runtime package. The managed package is only the C# binding, while the GPU packages bundle in-tree CUDA/TensorRT providers and are not automatically required merely because the external EP targets NVIDIA hardware. Confidence remains medium until the target EP repository confirms its ONNXRUNTIME_ROOT package contract.

evidence.summary: The issue says ORT 1.28.0 is pending validation and that release-candidate builds are available for testing.
The issue publishes Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime 1.28.0-rc.1 under NuGet CPU packages.
NuGet identifies this as a prerelease native package containing native libraries for supported platforms and the CPU execution provider.
The release manager reports incomplete onnxruntime-gpu publication on PyPI due to quota; that limitation does not apply to the selected NuGet CPU package.
The authoritative non-prerelease v1.28.0 release was published on 2026-07-25, so this RC is no longer active even though its issue remains open.
